correctness.rationale: Verified support <=3 for signed Walsh sums of independent vertex sets of C_n (n>=3). The cyclic two-state transfer matrices A=[[1,1],[1,0]] and B=[[1,-1],[1,0]] yield W_n(S)=tr(product(B A^(gap-1))). Exact A²=A+I gives Fibonacci recurrence separately in each positive gap. For two marked vertices H(1,2)=0 at n=3, H(1,e)<0 for e>=3 and H(d,e)>0 for d,e>=2 by seed signs and positive recurrence; one marked always F_n>0. Recomputed all 64 three-gap sign boxes with 1,2,3,H and all H corners 4,5 using independently written exact integer matrix multiplication; only six zero boxes are permutations of (1,2,3). Inductive positive recurrence propagates strict signs to arbitrary high gaps and proves no other cubic zero. Direct independent-set enumeration for 3<=n<=10 corroborates; proves 12 hexagon supports and exactly 3 triangle two-support zeros.
